## Edge Cases & Exception UI Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Does the specification define the UI layout, wording, and user actions for handling extremely large file sizes (e.g., exceeding backend 10MB limits)? [Edge Case, Gap]
  - *Addressed in [plan.md](../plan.md#L116) (§2: Invalid File State - size validation) and mapped to tasks [T011](../tasks.md#L58) and [T014](../tasks.md#L64).*
- [x] CHK013 Is there a specified UI behavior or confirmation dialog for scenarios where the user tries to exit or refresh the browser during an active file upload? [Edge Case, Gap]
  - *Addressed in [plan.md](../plan.md#L146) (§6: Exit Protection listener) and mapped to task [T028](../tasks.md#L109).*
- [x] CHK014 Does the specification define how the UI displays a session expiration event to the user (e.g., overlay, popup, redirect)? [Edge Case, Gap]
  - *Addressed in [plan.md](../plan.md#L147) (§6: Session Expiry handling) and mapped to task [T021](../tasks.md#L85).*
- [x] CHK015 Is the UI error message content and styling defined for when the backend REST API is completely offline? [Edge Case, Gap]
  - *Addressed in [plan.md](../plan.md#L148) (§6: Backend Offline detection) and mapped to tasks [T010](../tasks.md#L44) and [T027](../tasks.md#L108).*
